method_notes.flood: Provisional linear normalization of the latest 24-hour forecast rainfall; not calibrated to flood observations.
method_notes.fire: Provisional combination of relative building density and inverse relative road length; not a fire probability.
method_notes.earthquake: Unavailable until a verified vector fault or seismic hazard layer covering South Caloocan is obtained.
method_notes.vulnerability: Unavailable until approved population and vulnerability data is obtained.
